shapeSummary: Round wheel with its axis along Z, 66.7 mm diameter and 7.62 mm wide, centered at X=0 and Z=0 with the lowest point at Y=0 (wheel center at Y=33.35). It has a 3 mm thick ring tire, a thin 2 mm central web with five round spoke windows spaced at 72°, a solid 31 mm diameter hub the full width, and a hexagonal center bore of about 5 mm.
warnings: Diameter taken from 2-5/8 in (66.7 mm); the metadata value of 69 mm conflicts with it and is unverified.
Tire thickness, web thickness and z-position, and hub diameter are estimated from the image.
Spoke windows are approximated as round holes; the real windows are trapezoidal.
The hex bore size and shape are uncertain; 5 mm across was estimated from the image.
The encoder stripes, the small inner hub windows, the hub ribs and the logo are omitted.
Tire profile and rim depth are unknown and not modeled.

R=33.35
w=7.62
